description: Peers of a ticker: members of the 503-ticker S&P 500 seed universe sharing the ticker's industry (fallback: sector), ranked by market cap, with delayed quote fields. $0.005 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/screener/peers/{ticker}.
name: screener_peers
